alt: Two humanoid robots in mid-air collision during a race at the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, one sparking and catching fire while robot limbs scatter across the blue athletics track
story: At the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing — a competition designed to prove that humanoid robots can sprint, jump, and kick like people — multiple robots collided, disintegrated, and caught fire mid-race, including one that burst into flames at the finish line of the 100-metre sprint on August 25.
why_funny: The entire premise of the games was that AI-powered humanoid robots can safely compete in athletics; several immediately proved that premise aggressively wrong by exploding on contact with the foam crash pad.
